integrity: The proof independently translates finite models to nonnegative Boolean-atom counts, checks all four syllogistic sentence forms as linear Presburger constraints, proves dilation invariance by uniform model replication, and gives an explicit arbitrary-modulus partition theory. The primary source was inspected at its complete base-spectrum classification, sentence-level Boolean extension, and noun-level union/complement section including the modulus-three construction.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats finite theories in the noun-Boolean extension and gives an effective Presburger upper bound plus dilation closure and exact divisibility families. It does not classify exactly which semilinear dilation-closed sets are realizable, does not give efficient complexity bounds, and makes no claim for infinitary theories.
title: Boolean noun terms force effectively ultimately periodic finite spectra
